plants.name: Helianthus annuus
plants.description: Tall, sun-chasing stems carry broad golden-yellow petals around a dark, seed-packed centre. Whole fields of blooms turn their faces toward the light on warm late-summer days.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late summer, August through September in the northern Rocky Mountain and Southwest regions of North America
plants.location: Southwestern United States, including the high-desert landscapes around Santa Fe, New Mexico
plants.funFact: A sunflower head is not one flower but hundreds of tiny florets, arranged in interlocking spirals that follow the Fibonacci sequence.
